title: Layouts with unstored calculations
description: Performance rule — layouts ranked by how many unstored calculation fields they display. Each unstored calculation is re-evaluated for every visible record, so layouts that show many records at once and carry a high count are the most expensive to render.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Unstored calculation fields hold no value on disk and are evaluated on display. The cost scales with the number of such fields on a layout multiplied by the number of records shown, so a record-list layout with many unstored calculations can become a rendering bottleneck.
rule.remediation: Reduce the number of unstored calculations on high-traffic list layouts: store results where the inputs allow it, move heavy calculations to dedicated detail layouts, or replace them with stored/lookup values.

meta.name: Layouts with unstored calculations
meta.author: fm-lab rules
meta.description: Per-layout count of displayed unstored calculation fields, qualified by the decoded view type (Layouts.Default_View: Form/List/Table) and by how many placements sit inside portals — the two contexts that repeat the evaluation per visible row. Community calibration (WAN-first guidance): list and portal placements are the expensive class.
